objects.summary: Codex emits a complete WP2 V2 PATCH_BUNDLE before durable PASS: exact contents and SHA256 for synthetic_binding.py and its test, exact base parent, fixture/runner/evaluator/sink identities and test results. This preserves the tested candidate even if the worker disappears.
Owner restarts the exact-base WP2 mission on PR #39 with REUSE > CONNECT > REPAIR > BUILD, bounded synthetic-only scope and stop at implementation PASS pending independent review.

Independent remote verification still sees only the mission anchor, so the reported implementation is classified UNPUBLISHED_LOCAL_RESULT. Owner requires publication to the exact PR branch before any implementation-PASS claim.

Codex materializes the exact frozen bundle with matching hashes, reruns 8 WP2 tests and 29 targeted tests/subtests, commits qualification-only apparatus and reports WP2_IMPLEMENTATION_PASS_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; product code remains unchanged.

Exact bundle is published durably to PR #39 branch as remote commit 91a7d45..., directly descending from the mission anchor. Frozen hashes and tests are reverified; claim ceiling remains SELF_PASS != INDEPENDENT_PASS.

Independent review finds one narrow receipt-integrity defect: worker output and sink receipt alias the same mutable dict, allowing worker-added metadata after receipt_hash computation. Review rejects independent PASS and requires non-aliasing plus final persisted-hash verification only.

Codex V3 applies the minimal deep-copy non-aliasing repair, strengthens tests to recompute final sink receipt hash and prove worker metadata isolation, and emits a new complete exact-byte PATCH_BUNDLE before PASS. Product code remains unchanged.

Owner records durable independent closure on exact reviewed head d40053bd...: WP2 gap proven, repair PASS, causality proof PASS_BOUNDED_SYNTHETIC, independent code/evidence review PASS, product code unchanged, hosted CI explicitly NOT_PRESENT. WP1 and WP3 boundaries remain unchanged.

Bounded orchestrator persists WP2 closure and recomputes critical path: WP1 is sole global-join blocker; WP2 must stay closed absent contradiction; WP3 is at Owner gate. PR #39 is not merged and no authority/science/runtime boundary was crossed.

cross_object_findings.finding: V2 preserves exact tested bytes in the PR comment before any durable PASS, making candidate reconstruction possible even when workspace-only commits disappear. This directly repairs a demonstrated memory/restart failure mode.

Eight WP2 tests and targeted regressions were green, yet independent review reproduced a mutable-aliasing flaw that invalidated receipt-hash integrity. Green tests alone were insufficient; decision-changing challenge added value.
The correct fix was a deep-copy separation plus stronger receipt-hash assertions, not a new scheduler/evaluator/sink. Scope remained two qualification files and product code unchanged.
WP2 is independently closed only as bounded synthetic engineering proof. Hosted CI, production autonomy, scientific exposure, deployment, promotion and global join are explicitly not implied.
After WP2 closure, the orchestrator correctly stops reopening solved work: WP1 is the sole global-join blocker and WP3 is already at an Owner gate.
